what: Default reveal for sites built with Framer — when an element is half visible it goes from opacity 0 and 10px below into place with a damped spring (stiffness 400 · damping 30 · mass 1, settles with a slight overshoot in about .5s). With delays of .2 · .4 · .5 · .7… it becomes a chat demo where consultation bubbles and recommendation cards rise one by one

options.y: Distance initially pushed down (px), default 10 — 0 means opacity only
options.opacity: Initial opacity, default 0 (.1 in some brand)
options.amount: How much must be visible to start (0 to 1), default .5 — 0 if the original threshold is 0
options.m: Spring mass, default 1 (Brand hero large panel 167/40/1.7)
options.on: Document event name — if given, visibility is checked only after receiving that signal (app-video-card-landing detail: once fonts have all arrived, header and body rise together on lv:ready). If absent, it checks immediately on attach.

note: Spring analytic solution, root |1−x| < Stretched to the length cut at .002 and run as a single curve — the mid-speed from turning it back by hand is not carried over (it appears only once, so there is no difference)
